title: Which Bushels Stand Free on a Storage Agreement
content:
Which bushels count as free follows what stands against the lot. This rule governs releases out of store under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The governing terms

Where the agreement carries bushels pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt, the bushels free are the bushels on hand less the bushels pledged.

Where the agreement carries no bushels pledged and a conditioning charge stands on the account carrying points no shrink line covers, the bushels free are the bushels on hand less the shrink still to come off those points at the programme's handling shrink percentage.

And otherwise the bushels free are the bushels on hand.

## The shrink still to come off

The points not yet covered are the points the conditioning charges show less the points the shrink lines carry, never below nothing. The shrink still to come off them is the bushels on hand multiplied by those points multiplied by the programme's handling shrink percentage for each point, that product divided by one hundred and rounded to two decimal places.

| Programme | Handling shrink for each point (percent) |
| --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 0.50 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 0.50 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 0.50 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 0.50 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 0.40 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 0.40 |

## Reading it condition by condition

| Bushels pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt | Points the conditioning charges show that no shrink line covers | Bushels free |
| --- | --- | --- |
| some | any | the bushels on hand less the bushels pledged |
| none | more than nil | the bushels on hand less the shrink still to come off those points |
| none | nil | the bushels on hand |

Where the subtraction would fall below nothing, the bushels free stand at nothing.

## Worked figures, on hypothetical accounts

**An agreement with 17740 bushels on hand and 3000 pledged against an outstanding receipt.** The bushels free are 14740.

**An Open Storage Account with 17740 bushels on hand, nothing pledged, conditioning charges showing 3.2 points and shrink lines carrying 1.2 points.** Two points stand uncovered; the shrink still to come off is 17740 multiplied by 2.0 points multiplied by 0.50 percent, divided by one hundred, which is 177.40 bushels, so the bushels free are 17562.60.

**The same agreement with nothing pledged and every point covered by a shrink line.** The bushels free are the 17740 bushels on hand.
